connector.name: Nvoip MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Secure Nvoip MCP server for reports, call analytics, service quality, and business insights.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.nvoip.com.br over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace br.com.nvoip. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer access token issued by the Nvoip OAuth flow.
